CRIMINAL ALIEN & SHAM LAWYER LINKED TO MORE THAN 2,500 IMMIGRATION FORMS

Jose Gregorio Sosa Cardona, a Venezuelan national and lawful permanent resident of Downers Grove, Ill., operated Delta Global Solutions Inc., a company that worked with individuals applying for asylum, immigrant visas, permanent resident cards and other immigration benefits. 

👉Between 2020 and 2024, Sosa and two employees knowingly submitted false information to USCIS for their clients, many of whom were also Venezuelan. 

👉Sosa also falsely claimed to be an attorney licensed in Ohio and California.  

A grand jury returned a seven-count indictment, which was later increased to 13-counts, and ICE @HSI_HQ took him into custody last March.

Our special agents also assisted with the investigation that linked Sosa to more than 2,500 immigration form filings.

Sosa will serve nine years in federal prison for his crimes.

Memphis drug trafficker Antonio “Joe” Caldwell began a 19 ½-year prison sentence July 15 following an ICE @HSINashville probe with its @HSTFNCC partners.

Already on supervised release for two prior federal narcotics convictions, the 40-year-old was obtaining and supplying large quantities of narcotics — including fentanyl and meth — to distributors in West Tennessee.

Agents determined he maintained a drug distribution house in California where he directed individuals to for narcotics. They recovered fentanyl, meth and three firearms during a search of the house.

📸Investigators also intercepted parcels mailed by Caldwell that contained three kilos of fentanyl hidden in cans of rice.

Get more details in the comments⬇️
